k000.name: Rate is weight times tariff
k000.plainEnglish: The shipment price is the weight in hundredweight multiplied by the lane tariff.

k001.name: Minimum charge applies
k001.plainEnglish: A shipment is never priced below the lane's minimum charge.

k002.name: Fuel surcharge percentage
k002.plainEnglish: A fuel surcharge is added as a percentage of the base price, read from settings.

k003.name: Tariff import rejects negative values
k003.plainEnglish: A tariff import is refused when any cell holds a negative number.

k004.name: Tariff import accepts blank cells
k004.plainEnglish: Blank tariff cells are imported as zero.
k004.suspectedDefect: Blank cells silently price a lane at zero.
k004.smeQuestion: Should a blank tariff cell block the import?

k005.name: Only staff edit tariffs
k005.plainEnglish: Only staff accounts may edit a tariff.

k006.name: Tariff versions are kept
k006.plainEnglish: Saving a tariff creates a new version and keeps the old one.

k007.name: Discount codes cap at 20%
k007.plainEnglish: A discount code can reduce the price by at most 20%.

k008.name: Discount code must be active
k008.plainEnglish: An inactive or expired discount code is refused at checkout.

k009.name: Discount code expiry
k009.plainEnglish: A discount code stops working at midnight on its expiry date.

k010.name: Booking needs a move date
k010.plainEnglish: A booking request is refused without a move date.

k011.name: Move date not in the past
k011.plainEnglish: A move date in the past is refused.

k012.name: Booking starts as draft
k012.plainEnglish: A new booking is saved with status draft.

k013.name: Draft becomes confirmed on payment
k013.plainEnglish: A draft booking becomes confirmed when its deposit is paid.

k014.name: Consumer sees own bookings only
k014.plainEnglish: A consumer can list and open only their own bookings.

k015.name: Deposit is 10 percent
k015.plainEnglish: The deposit is 10% of the quoted price, rounded to cents.

k016.name: Cancelled booking frees the mover
k016.plainEnglish: Cancelling a booking releases the mover's calendar slot.

k017.name: No refund after the move date
k017.plainEnglish: A booking cancelled on or after its move date gets no refund.
k017.smeQuestion: Is the no-refund rule intended for moves cancelled on the day?

k018.name: Cancel reason is optional
k018.plainEnglish: A cancellation may be submitted without a reason.

k019.name: Late cancellation fee
k019.plainEnglish: Cancelling within 48 hours of the move charges 25% of the deposit.
k019.suspectedDefect: The fee is taken from the deposit even when it was refunded.
